_comment: Every number the published site displays, with a Trutina grade and a basis (R9).
A figure carrying `derive` is RECOMPUTED from this repository on every build and
the build fails if it disagrees with `value`. A figure without `derive` was
produced by a run whose output is not committed as machine-readable JSON; its
`basis` names that run, and only a human can keep it true. Do not add `derive`
to such a figure to silence the difference -- the difference is the information.
`volatile` means the derivation STAMPS the value rather than checking it (the
commit under build changes every commit; pinning it would make the gate useless).
To advance the position flag: change `position` to the stop id and push.

head_sha.basis: git rev-parse HEAD at build time

head_date.basis: commit date of HEAD; no wall-clock read, so the build is deterministic (R8)

seal_fingerprint.basis: same ledger -> signature.key_fingerprint; tools/verify_manifest.py --pin-fingerprint checks it every CI run

bench_programs.basis: same ledger -> vector_counts, one public split per program

heldout_vectors.basis: same ledger -> vector_counts, held-out splits summed

public_vectors.basis: same ledger -> vector_counts, public splits summed

c1_seal_ber.basis: same ledger -> baselines_recorded.C1_rulebased.ber_overall; the pre-implementation red recorded AT sealing

suite_passed.basis: .github/workflows/tests.yml -> EXPECTED_PASSES, the value CI asserts the run against

suite_failed.basis: the gate fails the job on any failure; there is no continue-on-error in that workflow

ber_heldout.basis: CI job 95240930271, PR #15 @ 8c676e9, 2026-08-16. NOT derivable here: bench/results/C1_rulebased.json holds the pre-implementation v1.2 baseline, not this run, and the held-out vectors never enter this repository (R3)

ber_matched.basis: same CI run; all seven programs matched on every held-out vector

build_rate.basis: same CI run; 7 of 7 programs compiled

branch_coverage.basis: same CI run, JaCoCo 0.8.12 -- the coverage tool the ledger requires

layout_roundtrip.basis: docs/PHASE2_LOG.md WP-2.2 section 2, against the sealed oracle, tolerance zero

demo_inputs.basis: python3 -m demo over the committed corpus, one run; equals the sealed public-vector count because the demo executes exactly that set

demo_seconds.basis: same run, approximate wall time quoted in demo/README.md

carddemo_seconds.basis: WP-1.9 dry run over AWS CardDemo (Apache-2.0), zero intervention

cov_carddemo.basis: WP-1.5.4/1.5.5 re-run of the WP-1.9 dry runs. PLAUSIBLE, not VERIFIED: not one third-party program parsed cleanly under the then-bundled grammar, so every figure was taken through the token_scan fallback. The grammar was replaced at WP-2.0 and this has not been re-measured since

cov_omp.basis: same run, same token_scan caveat (OMP COBOL course, CC-BY-4.0)

cov_gnucobol.basis: same run, same token_scan caveat (GnuCOBOL test suite, GPL-3.0)

demand_total.basis: unsupported-construct occurrences across the three dry-run corpora; same token_scan caveat

release_fingerprint.basis: derived by the operator on 2026-08-21 from visionblox-release-key-v1.pub -- PUBLIC material only, SHA-256 over the 32 raw Ed25519 bytes, first 16 hex. Not derived here: the public key is not yet in this repository, which is the one open item that would close it

countersignatures.basis: both dry runs read VALID AND UNATTESTED; the flow is proven only under a stand-in key generated inside a test

migrations.basis: no customer engagement has been run; stated in README.md
